name: com.hoonex.solarnet
description: Local-first turn-based multiplayer engine with Nearby and Bluetooth Classic transports, deterministic resync, room/lobby lifecycle, Unity diagnostics, and a playable 2D sample.

samples.description: Two-phone Android diagnostics for Nearby, Bluetooth Classic, room lifecycle, and turn packets.
Playable 5x5 two-player turn game running through two real SolarTurnSession instances over LoopbackTransport.
